lesson_scope: Direct collisions of particles and spheres; calculating initial and final kinetic energies; calculating kinetic energy loss in inelastic collisions; relating energy loss to coalescence and post-impact speeds; expressing kinetic energy loss algebraically and determining unknown masses or initial velocities; combining collision kinetic energy loss with subsequent motion under friction or inclined planes.
